opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort/filter
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, optionally in TrueBlue points, then open Sort & Filter and sort by {sort_order} (and departure airports) to review cheapest options.
steps: Open jetblue.com Flights tab
Set trip type (Roundtrip/One-way)
Type origin in From and pick airport/city area from dropdown
Type destination in To and pick airport
Pick depart date (and return date) in calendar
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points'
Click Search flights and confirm any modal (Continue to flight results)
Optionally toggle Dollars/Points
Click Sort & Filter, choose sort (Price low to high / Price by Core), set departure airports, click Apply
Review results

instances.values: JFK -> MIA, roundtrip Mar 27 - Mar 31, view in points, sort Price by Core
NYC area -> Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, sort Price low to high, LGA+JFK
NYC area -> Aruba AUA, roundtrip May 1 - May 5, TrueBlue points, sort Price low to high

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United's Car rental tab for a pickup at {location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date} with {pickup_time}/{dropoff_time} and click Find cars.
steps: Open united.com Book > Car tab
Type pickup location and select suggestion
Open Rental dates and pick pickup date then drop-off date
Optionally set pickup time and drop-off time dropdowns
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Click Find cars

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), Apr 8 - Apr 13, 8:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m., book with miles
Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9 - Apr 15, 10:00 a.m. default times

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search by filters
opportunities.description: From Budget site footer go to Careers > Openings and filter jobs by {country}, {team}, {time_type}, then search and open a matching job.
steps: On budget.com footer click Careers
Click Openings
Open Country filter and select country
Open Team filter and select team
Open Time Type filter and select type
Click Search by job title or keyword
Open a job posting and click Apply Now

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park search by filter
opportunities.description: On nps.gov Find a Park, filter parks by {state}/{activity}/{topic} and search, then browse results.
steps: Open nps.gov home and go to Find a Park / See All Parks
Open By Activity or By Topic (or State) dropdown
Select filter value
Click Search
Scroll through results

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll rate lookup by vehicle
opportunities.description: On mta.info navigate to Bridges & Tunnels tolls > Tolls by vehicle and open the toll rates for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open mta.info
Open Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels (or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Click Tolls by vehicle / Toll Rates
Select vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Read rates for the bridge/tunnel
